title: v1_113 / Thank you
content: ## Thank you ### Issue tracking Contributions to our issue tracking: * [@gjsjohnmurray (John Murray)](https://github.com/gjsjohnmurray) * [@RedCMD (RedCMD)](https://github.com/RedCMD) * [@IllusionMH (Andrii Dieiev)](https://github.com/IllusionMH) * [@albertosantini (Alberto Santini)](https://github.com/albertosantini) Contributions to `vscode`: * [@jcansdale (Jamie Cansdale)](https://github.com/jcansdale): Use bracketed paste for multiline executed terminal text [PR #302526](https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/pull/302526) * [@jeevaratnamputla](https://github.com/jeevaratnamputla): Replace child_process.exec with execFile to prevent potential command injection [PR #291825](https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/pull/291825) * [@kbhujbal (Kunal Bhujbal)](https://github.com/kbhujbal): Fix code quality issues: error logging and JSDoc typo [PR #297893](https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/pull/297893) * [@sathvikc (Sathvik C)](https://github.com/sathvikc): fix: prevent duplicate tip nodes on re-entrant renderGettingStartedTipIfNeeded [PR #302317](https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/pull/302317) * [@ShehabSherif0 (Shehab Sherif)](https://github.com/ShehabSherif0): Fix missing global flag in sanitizeId regex [PR #303603](https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/pull/303603) * [@xingsy97 (xingsy97)](https://github.com/xingsy97): Git - optimize worktree ignored-path computation [PR #303955](https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/pull/303955) Contributions to `vscode-copilot-chat`: * [@24anisha (Anisha Agarwal)](https://github.com/24anisha) * Search subagent -- resolve relative and absolute paths [PR #4429](https://github.com/microsoft/vscode-copilot-chat/pull/4429) * System prompt updates to handle search subagent [PR #4500](https://github.com/microsoft/vscode-copilot-chat/pull/4500) * [@etvorun (ET)](https://github.com/etvorun): Fix: NES debounce and language context fetch do not honor cancellation token [PR #4384](https://github.com/microsoft/vscode-copilot-chat/pull/4384) Contributions to `vscode-python-environments`: * [@00zayn](https://github.com/00zayn): Fix spurious unresolved interpreter warning from ${workspaceFolder}-scoped global defaultInterpreterPath [PR #1334](https://github.com/microsoft/vscode-python-environments/pull/1334) * [@StellaHuang95 (Stella Huang)](https://github.com/StellaHuang95): Add telemetry for manager registration failures [PR #1365](https://github.com/microsoft/vscode-python-environments/pull/1365) Contributions to `vscode-windows-process-tree`: * [@ZA139](https://github.com/ZA139): feat：Add getAllProcesses API for retrieving all system processes [PR #84](https://github.com/microsoft/vscode-windows-process-tree/pull/84) --- We really appreciate people trying our new features as soon as they are ready, so check back here often and learn what's new. >If you'd like to read release notes for previous VS Code versions, go to [Updates](https://code.visualstudio.com/updates) on [code.visualstudio.com](https://code.visualstudio.com).
